title: Control workflows
description: Runs, pauses, resumes or inspects a workflow of the same workspace, lists recent failures, or answers a chat command (/run, /pause, /resume, /status, /failures, /help). It acts as the user who published this workflow, with that user's permissions. Output of command also has reply (plain text to send back) and ok.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: run, pause, resume, status, list_failures, or command (parse a chat message such as /status My workflow).

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Target workflow: its id, or its exact name (case-insensitive) in this workspace. Required except for command; for list_failures an empty value means the whole workspace.

input.title: Run input
input.description: Used by run: the trigger input given to the target workflow.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Used by list_failures: how many recent failures to return (1 to 20, default 5).

text.title: Chat text
text.description: Used by command: the raw chat message, for example {{ trigger.input.message.text }}.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Used by command: who sent the message, for example {{ trigger.input.message.from.id }}. Must be one of allowedSenders, otherwise the command is refused.

allowedSenders.title: Allowed senders
allowedSenders.description: Used by command: sender ids (for example Telegram user ids) allowed to control workflows. Required for command, at least one.
